I have a complete picture of the "owner identity" implementation. Here is the full report.

## Overview

This is the `spring-petclinic-rest` project (Maven, `pom.xml` at `/home/daniel/sandbox/pom.xml`, artifact `spring-petclinic-rest` v4.0.2 on Spring Boot 4.1.0). Owner-identity logic lives in two places: pure helper classes under `util/`, and OfficeFloor pipeline "functions" under `rest/function/owner/`. The owner response DTO (`OwnerDto`) is **generated at build time** by the `openapi-generator-maven-plugin` from `src/main/resources/openapi.yml` into `target/generated-sources` (package `org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.dto`), so the DTO contract lives in the OpenAPI spec, not in hand-written Java.

Important finding on "version": there is **no `apiVersion` and no nested `identity` object anywhere in the current implementation**. `memberId`, `identityKey`, `householdId` are all top-level fields on the owner schema. The only place `apiVersion`/nested `identity` appears is the acceptance test `AcceptanceTest.java`, which encodes a *target* contract ("identity-v2") that the code does not yet satisfy. Similarly there is **no `schemaVersion`** anywhere; the audit event is fixed at an implicit V1 shape with an `event` marker but no version field. The only versioning concept present is `FiscalYear` ("FY26" labels), which is unrelated to API/schema versioning.

---

## 1. Region code derivation

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/CityLocality.java`** — resolves the canonical region. Prefers the postcode range (via `Postcodes.regionForPostcode`), falls back to a fixed city table (Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD), else `"UNKNOWN"`.

Key API: `forCity(String)`, `forPostcodeOrCity(String postcode, String city)`, constant `UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"`, table `CITY_REGION = {Sydney→NSW, Melbourne→VIC, Brisbane→QLD}`.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/RegionTimezone.java`** — maps region → IANA timezone. Table `REGION_TIMEZONE = {NSW→Australia/Sydney, VIC→Australia/Melbourne, QLD→Australia/Brisbane}`; `forRegion(String)` returns `null` for unknown/UNKNOWN.

**`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/MemberId.java`** — also owns region *extraction* from an existing member-id via `regionOf(String memberId)` (leading letters before the first digit, robust to the `-<n>` dedup suffix).

(`Postcodes.java` at `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/Postcodes.java` holds the postcode→region ranges NSW 2000-2099 / VIC 3000-3099 / QLD 4000-4099 — referenced but I did not read it in full; flag if you need it.)

---

## 2. The identifiers: memberId, identityKey, householdId

### memberId
Format `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>` (e.g. `NSW261A2B3C4D7`).

- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/MemberId.java`** — owns the format. `of(region, shortFiscalYear, hash8)` composes `String.format("%s%02d%s", ...)` then appends `LuhnCheckDigit.of(body)`. `deduplicate(memberId, existing)` appends `-<n>` (n starts at 2) on collision. `regionOf(...)` reads the region back out. Constant `DEDUP_SEPARATOR = '-'`.
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignOwnerMemberId.java`** — the pipeline step that derives it: region from `CityLocality.forPostcodeOrCity(postcode, city)`, fiscal year from `FiscalYear.shortYearOf(registrationDate)`, `hash8 = Sha256.upperHexPrefix(telephone + lastName, 8)`, then `MemberId.of(...)` and dedup against all existing `Owner::getMemberId`.
- Getter/setter: `Owner.getMemberId()` / `setMemberId()` (`model/Owner.java` lines 256-262). `Owner.getPrimaryIdentifier()` (lines 270-272) returns `memberId` and is the single source of truth used by the audit event.

### householdId
First 12 upper-case hex chars of SHA-256 of `normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode`; null when no postcode.

- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Households.java`** — `idFor(lastName, postcode)` (the derivation), plus `membersOf(...)` and `maxMembershipLevel(...)`. Name normalization: trim, collapse whitespace, lowercase.
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignHouseholdId.java`** — pipeline step calling `owner.setHouseholdId(Households.idFor(lastName, postcode))`.
- Getter/setter: `Owner.getHouseholdId()` / `setHouseholdId()` (lines 280-286).

### identityKey
64-char lower-case SHA-256 hex of `telephone + "|" + lowercasedEmail + "|" + Soundex(lastName)`. **Derived on-the-fly in the model getter, never persisted or set anywhere.**

- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`** `getIdentityKey()` (lines 525-530). No `setIdentityKey` exists.
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/Identities.java`** — `duplicatesOf(...)` (hard duplicate: same identity key, fetched by telephone) and `softMatchesOf(...)` (same postcode + phonetically-equal name via `Soundex` but different key).
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/EnsureUniqueIdentity.java`** — the 409 duplicate block; bypassed when request has `sharesHousehold=true`. Throws `DuplicateIdentityException(owner.getIdentityKey())`.
- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/escalation/DuplicateIdentityException.java`** — carries the `identityKey`.

Shared hashing helper: **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/Sha256.java`** (`upperHexPrefix(value, length)` upper-hex prefix used for memberId hash8; `lowerHex(value)` full 64-char lower-hex used for identityKey). Note: `Households` has its *own* inline SHA-256 helper rather than reusing `Sha256`.

---

## 3. Owner response shape / DTO

The response body is `OwnerDto`, **generated from the OpenAPI schema**. The mapping and pipeline:

- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — MapStruct `toOwnerDto(Owner)`; adds `displayName` and `selfLink` expressions. All identity fields (`memberId`, `identityKey`, `householdId`, `locality`, `timezone`, `ownerSegment`, etc.) map by name from the `Owner` getters.
- Responders: **`RespondWithOwner.java`** (GET), **`RespondWithOwnerCreated.java`** (POST, 201 + Location), **`RespondWithOwnerUpdated.java`** (204) — all in `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`. Each just calls `ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner)`.
- GET pipeline wiring: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/owners/{ownerId}.GET.yml` (LoadOwner → RespondWithOwner).

The DTO field contract (source of truth) is in **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`**, owner schema roughly lines 2095-2276. Relevant identity fields and where they map from `Owner`:
- `memberId` (line 2139), `householdId` (2145) — top level, `readOnly`.
- `locality` (2182) ← `Owner.getLocality()` (lines 396-399: `MemberId.regionOf(memberId)`, else `CityLocality.forPostcodeOrCity`).
- `timezone` (2188) ← `Owner.getTimezone()` (lines 419-421: `RegionTimezone.forRegion(getLocality())`).
- `ownerSegment` (2194) — enum `PREMIUM_METRO|PREMIUM_REGIONAL|STANDARD_METRO|STANDARD_REGIONAL`, ← `Owner.getOwnerSegment()`.
- `identityKey` (2236) ← `Owner.getIdentityKey()`.
- Plus `membershipLevel`, `membershipPoints`, `fiscalYear`, `namesakeCount`, `possibleDuplicate`, `riskFlag`, `deleted`, etc.

There is **no `apiVersion` field and no nested `identity` grouping** in this schema.

---

## 4. Audit event / audit schema

- **`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AuditOwnerCreated.java`** — logs to a dedicated SLF4J logger named `"AUDIT"`: a human-readable line (`id`, `memberId`, `registrationDate`, `membershipLevel`) plus the JSON of an `OwnerCreatedEvent`.     Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical API path to this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by a space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: "The owner's member-id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the canonical region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city), the two-digit fiscal year of the registration date (fiscal year starting 1 July), the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>', assigned at creation."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: "Stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name and postcode): the first twelve hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and postcode, so every such owner resolves to the same value automatically. Null when the owner has no postcode."
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The owner's fiscal year: the 'FY<YY>' label of the business-day-adjusted registration date, where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the last two digits of its ending calendar year (e.g. 'FY26' for 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026). Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "The owner's membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when the owner has an email address, plus 1 when the owner had no namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 when the owner's household has 3 or more members, and plus 3 once the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's locality: the canonical region carried in the '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' member-id, derived at creation by preferring the postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falling back to the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The owner's timezone: the IANA name for the owner's locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the region has no known timezone. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's market segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': the tier is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; the area is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "Whether this owner was part of a bulk signup: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration date at the moment it was created, false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "Whether this owner's city was approaching its capacity limit when this owner was created: true when the city already held between 40 and 49 owners (the hard limit being 50), false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band as at their registration date: 'MINOR' for under 18, 'ADULT' for 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' for 65 and over. Present only when a birth date is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The owner's identity key: the 64-character lower-case SHA-256 hex of the normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when absent) and the Soundex code of the last name, joined by '|'. Two owners collide on this key only when they share a telephone, an email and a phonetically-equal surname, so it is the fingerprint the create endpoint's duplicate check keys off.               type: boolean

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The owner's personal title. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Stored and returned as given, and used to compose the 'salutation'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility, and always returned. When structured address fields are supplied, this is the composed form: the normalized 'addressLine1', plus a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, street types expanded) and echoed back.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+0-9() ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when supplied. When present it must be four digits and, for a city in a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it determines the owner's age band as at their registration date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares its household (same last name and postcode); the new owner is created as a declared household member and bypasses the household duplicate block. Write-only; accepted on input but never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical API path to this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by a space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: "The owner's member-id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>': the canonical region derived from the postcode (falling back to the city), the two-digit fiscal year of the registration date (fiscal year starting 1 July), the first eight upper-case hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, and a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>', assigned at creation."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: "Stable shared identifier for owners who share a household (same last name and postcode): the first twelve hex characters of the SHA-256 of the normalized last name and postcode, so every such owner resolves to the same value automatically. Null when the owner has no postcode."
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The owner's fiscal year: the 'FY<YY>' label of the business-day-adjusted registration date, where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the last two digits of its ending calendar year (e.g. 'FY26' for 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026). Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "The owner's membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when the owner has an email address, plus 1 when the owner had no namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 when the owner's household has 3 or more members, and plus 3 once the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's locality: the canonical region carried in the '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' member-id, derived at creation by preferring the postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falling back to the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The owner's timezone: the IANA name for the owner's locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the region has no known timezone. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's market segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': the tier is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; the area is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "Whether this owner was part of a bulk signup: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration date at the moment it was created, false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "Whether this owner's city was approaching its capacity limit when this owner was created: true when the city already held between 40 and 49 owners (the hard limit being 50), false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band as at their registration date: 'MINOR' for under 18, 'ADULT' for 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' for 65 and over. Present only when a birth date is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The owner's identity key: the 64-character lower-case SHA-256 hex of the normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when absent) and the Soundex code of the last name, joined by '|'. Two owners collide on this key only when they share a telephone, an email and a phonetically-equal surname, so it is the fingerprint the create endpoint's duplicate check keys off. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '3b1c...'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "Whether this owner resembles an existing one: true when, at creation, it shared an existing owner's postcode and a phonetically-equal last name (Soundex) yet differed in identity key and was not a declared household member, false otherwise. A declared member (created with 'sharesHousehold') is a genuine member, not a suspected duplicate. When true, 'possibleDuplicateOf' holds that owner's id."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same postcode and a phonetically-equal last name but a different identity key), or null when 'possibleDuplicate' is false."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: "Whether this owner warrants a closer look: true when any risk signal holds - it is a possible duplicate, its email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a blocked disposable domain's base label, such as a subdomain or a look-alike on another top-level domain), or its city was over its soft capacity at creation (capacityWarning) - false otherwise. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: "Whether this owner has been soft-deleted: true once a DELETE has flagged the record (which is retained rather than removed), false for a live owner. A newly created owner is not deleted. A deleted owner is still returned by GET, but is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:

          description: Pet owners in the requested page.

        page:

          type: integer

          title: Size

          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:

        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages

      type: object
      properties:

          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The owner's personal title. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Stored and returned as given, and used to compose the 'salutation'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility, and always returned. When structured address fields are supplied, this is the composed form: the normalized 'addressLine1', plus a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, street types expanded) and echoed back.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+0-9() ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when supplied. When present it must be four digits and, for a city in a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it determines the owner's age band as at their registration date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares its household (same last name and postcode); the new owner is created as a declared household member and bypasses the household duplicate block. Write-only; accepted on input but never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical API path to this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by a space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: "The owner-identity API version. Version 2 groups the identifiers under the 'identity' object and derives each identifier with a version-2 algorithm."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The owner's fiscal year: the 'FY<YY>' label of the business-day-adjusted registration date, where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the last two digits of its ending calendar year (e.g. 'FY26' for 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026). Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "The owner's membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when the owner has an email address, plus 1 when the owner had no namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 when the owner's household has 3 or more members, and plus 3 once the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's locality: the canonical region carried in the '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' member-id, derived at creation by preferring the postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falling back to the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The owner's timezone: the IANA name for the owner's locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the region has no known timezone. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's market segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': the tier is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; the area is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "Whether this owner was part of a bulk signup: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration date at the moment it was created, false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "Whether this owner's city was approaching its capacity limit when this owner was created: true when the city already held between 40 and 49 owners (the hard limit being 50), false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band as at their registration date: 'MINOR' for under 18, 'ADULT' for 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' for 65 and over. Present only when a birth date is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: "The owner's identity key: the 64-character lower-case SHA-256 hex of the normalized telephone, the lower-cased email (or empty when absent) and the Soundex code of the last name, joined by '|'. Two owners collide on this key only when they share a telephone, an email and a phonetically-equal surname, so it is the fingerprint the create endpoint's duplicate check keys off. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '3b1c...'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "Whether this owner resembles an existing one: true when, at creation, it shared an existing owner's postcode and a phonetically-equal last name (Soundex) yet differed in identity key and was not a declared household member, false otherwise. A declared member (created with 'sharesHousehold') is a genuine member, not a suspected duplicate. When true, 'possibleDuplicateOf' holds that owner's id."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same postcode and a phonetically-equal last name but a different identity key), or null when 'possibleDuplicate' is false."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: "Whether this owner warrants a closer look: true when any risk signal holds - it is a possible duplicate, its email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a blocked disposable domain's base label, such as a subdomain or a look-alike on another top-level domain), or its city was over its soft capacity at creation (capacityWarning) - false otherwise. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: "Whether this owner has been soft-deleted: true once a DELETE has flagged the record (which is retained rather than removed), false for a live owner. A newly created owner is not deleted. A deleted owner is still returned by GET, but is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of pets matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetFields:
      title: Pet fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet.
          type: string
          maxLength: 30
          example: Leo
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The date of birth of the pet.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2010-09-07'
          x-field-extra-annotation: "@org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.validation.PetAgeValidation"
        type:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetType'
      required:
        - name
        - birthDate
        - type
    Pet:
      title: Pet
      description: A pet.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            ownerId:
              title: Owner ID
              description: The ID of the pet's owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            visits:
              title: Visits
              description: Vet visit bookings for this pet.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Visit'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - id
            - type
            - visits
    VetFields:
      title: VetFields
      description: Editable fields of a veterinarian.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: 'James'
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the vet.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: 'Carter'
        specialties:
          title: Specialties
          description: The specialties of the vet.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Specialty'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    Vet:
      title: Vet
      description: A veterinarian.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VetFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the vet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
      required:
        - id
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - specialties
    VisitFields:
      title: Visit fields
      description: Editable fields of a vet visit.
      type: object
      properties:
        date:
          title: Date
          description: The date of the visit.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        description:
          title: Description
          description: The description for the visit.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'rabies shot'
      required:
        - description
    Visit:
      title: Visit
      description: A booking for a vet visit.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/VisitFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the visit.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            petId:
              title: Pet ID
              description: The ID of the pet.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
            - petId
    PetTypeFields:
      title: PetType fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet type.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the pet type.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: cat
      required:
        - name
    PetType:
      title: Pet type
      description: A pet type.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/PetTypeFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet type.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
          required:
            - id
    User:
      title: User
      description: An user.
      type: object
      properties:
        username:
          title: username
          description: The username
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: john.doe
        password:
          title: Password
          description: The password
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: 1234abc
        enabled:
          title: enabled
          description: Indicates if the user is enabled
          type: boolean
          example: true
        roles:
          title: Roles
          description: The roles of an user
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Role'
      required:
        - username
    Role:
      title: Role
      description: A role.
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          title: name
          description: The role's name
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: admin
      required:
        - name

              description: An ID for this version of the response.

              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

        description: The details of the new pet.

                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        404:
          description: Pet or Owner not found.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'
        500:
          description: Server error.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ProblemDetail'

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: "The owner's personal title. Optional; one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Stored and returned as given, and used to compose the 'salutation'."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: "The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward compatibility, and always returned. When structured address fields are supplied, this is the composed form: the normalized 'addressLine1', plus a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2' when present."
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when supplied. Normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, street types expanded) and echoed back.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form (a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-+0-9() ]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: "The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional; validated only when supplied. When present it must be four digits and, for a city in a known region (Sydney->NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne->VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane->QLD 4000-4099), fall within that region's range. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned as given."
          type: string
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. Optional; when supplied it determines the owner's age band as at their registration date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already shares its household (same last name and postcode); the new owner is created as a declared household member and bypasses the household duplicate block. Write-only; accepted on input but never returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: "The canonical API path to this owner: '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id."
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: "The owner's salutation: the title and last name separated by a space (e.g. 'DR Who'), or just the last name when no title is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: "The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes. The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: "The owner-identity API version. Version 2 groups the identifiers under the 'identity' object and derives each identifier with a version-2 algorithm."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: "The number of existing owners that shared this owner's first and last name (compared case-insensitively) at the moment this owner was created."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: "The owner's fiscal year: the 'FY<YY>' label of the business-day-adjusted registration date, where the fiscal year starts on 1 July and is identified by the last two digits of its ending calendar year (e.g. 'FY26' for 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026). Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "The owner's membership points: starts at 0, plus 2 when the owner has an email address, plus 1 when the owner had no namesakes at creation (namesakeCount is 0), plus 2 when the owner's household has 3 or more members, and plus 3 once the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "The owner's membership level, from 1 to 4, derived from membershipPoints: level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "The owner's locality: the canonical region carried in the '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' member-id, derived at creation by preferring the postcode range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099) and falling back to the fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' otherwise."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "The owner's timezone: the IANA name for the owner's locality via the fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the region has no known timezone. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: "The owner's market segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>': the tier is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'; the area is 'METRO' when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: "Whether this owner was part of a bulk signup: true when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's registration date at the moment it was created, false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: "Whether this owner's city was approaching its capacity limit when this owner was created: true when the city already held between 40 and 49 owners (the hard limit being 50), false otherwise."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "The owner's age band as at their registration date: 'MINOR' for under 18, 'ADULT' for 18 to 64, or 'SENIOR' for 65 and over. Present only when a birth date is recorded. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "The owner's preferred contact channel: 'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: "Whether this owner resembles an existing one: true when, at creation, it shared an existing owner's postcode and a phonetically-equal last name (Soundex) yet differed in identity key and was not a declared household member, false otherwise. A declared member (created with 'sharesHousehold') is a genuine member, not a suspected duplicate. When true, 'possibleDuplicateOf' holds that owner's id."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: "The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same postcode and a phonetically-equal last name but a different identity key), or null when 'possibleDuplicate' is false."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: "Whether this owner warrants a closer look: true when any risk signal holds - it is a possible duplicate, its email domain is disposable-adjacent (shares a blocked disposable domain's base label, such as a subdomain or a look-alike on another top-level domain), or its city was over its soft capacity at creation (capacityWarning) - false otherwise. Derived from stored state, never persisted."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: "Whether this owner has been soft-deleted: true once a DELETE has flagged the record (which is retained rather than removed), false for a live owner. A newly created owner is not deleted. A deleted owner is still returned by GET, but is ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks."
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

All 16 tests pass and the build is green. Here's a summary of what I changed to release **version 2 of the owner identity**.

## The design

I introduced one small class that owns the version, so every consumer stays in step:

**`util/OwnerIdentityVersion.java`** (new) — holds `API_VERSION = 2`, `AUDIT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2`, the fixed `TAG = "V2"`, and `regionCode(region)` which mixes the tag into the plain region (e.g. `"NSW"` → `"V2NSW"`).

## Identity derivation (V2 region code inside every identifier)

- **memberId** (`AssignOwnerMemberId`) — the region component is now `OwnerIdentityVersion.regionCode(...)`, so it becomes `V2NSW261A2B3C4D7`.
- **householdId** (`Households.idFor`) — the `V2` tag is mixed into the hashed material.
- **identityKey** (`Owner.getIdentityKey`) — the `V2` tag is mixed into the hashed material.

Because the tag enters every preimage/prefix, each identifier changes and no V1 value can be reproduced.

## Keeping the V2 tag out of the user-facing region

- **`Owner.getLocality()`** now derives the plain region straight from the stored postcode/city (`CityLocality`) instead of reading it back out of the (now V2-tagged) member-id. So `locality` stays `"NSW"`, `timezone` and the **owner segment**'s METRO/REGIONAL area recompute correctly from that plain region.
- Removed the now-unused `MemberId.regionOf` (its only caller was the old `getLocality`).

## Response shape

In `openapi.yml` I added an `OwnerIdentity` schema and moved `memberId`/`householdId`/`identityKey` off the top level into a nested `identity` object, plus a top-level integer `apiVersion`. `OwnerMapper` populates `apiVersion` (from `API_VERSION`) and builds the nested `OwnerIdentityDto`. This matches the acceptance test's exact structural contract.

## Audit schema

`OwnerCreatedEvent.toJson()` now leads with `"schemaVersion":2`; its `memberId` automatically carries the V2 member-id.

Request fields are unchanged. Test result: `Tests run: 16, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.
